sources.content: Chief complaint: fever and productive cough for 3 days. 68-year-old man. Denies chest pain, hemoptysis. History of hypertension. Allergy: penicillin (rash).
Exam on 2026-03-02: Temp 38.6 °C, HR 104 bpm, BP 128/76 mmHg, RR 22 /min, SpO2 93% on room air. Crackles at the right lung base.
Labs: WBC 15.2 ×10^9/L, CRP 126 mg/L, creatinine 88 µmol/L. Chest X-ray: right lower lobe consolidation. Blood cultures pending. 2026-03-04 sputum culture grew Streptococcus pneumoniae.
